text:
Elena: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on org & hiring changes. Posting the short clarifications and happy to answer q's here. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/reorg-q3 (internal)

Sahil: thx. two quick ones: 1) timeline — when do transfers and role-posts go live? 2) will we backfill ICs vs prioritize new roles?

Elena: Good q. Timeline: role posts and official transfer window open Mon 2026-06-02. Offers and hires will be phased across Q3. Backfill policy: preserve critical IC gaps for product/team continuity; where we hold headcount it's for backfill. For growth bets (Optimize, Platform infra) we add net new hires. High-level: +18 net engineers this FY, split infra 7 / product 6 / platform & tools 5.

Maya: Are managers expected to move with teams, or will we get reassign notices? I have 2 folks flagged for potential move.

Elena: Managers will be consulted; we prefer voluntary transitions first. HR will send targeted outreach this week. If a manager is needed to stay, we'll note that in the transfer ops doc.

Jun: For Eng Platform — any immediate impact to oncall or SLAs during transfers? We run a 2-week overlap for people leaving to ensure handoffs.

Priya: oncall question: will rotations change headcount math? we budgeted current oncall load per team.

Elena: Ops note: rotations won't change until the transfer window closes. If team size drops below N=5 we may temporarily reduce pages or redistribute. We'll publish a migration checklist and a 2-week overlap requirement.

Sahil: thx. clarifying: the +18 is net new or gross new? you listed splits but curious about total headcount delta vs replaced roles.

Elena: +18 net new (i.e., new positions after accounting for internal moves and attrition). Gross postings ~ +32 because of internal transfers and expected attrition.

Maya: Will there be changes to leveling or IC ladders? A few folks worried about scope changes.

Elena: No broad relvel. Individual scope adjustments will be handled by managers + TL with calibration sessions. If someone's manager changes, we'll do a secondary calibration review.

Priya: Any changes to hiring priorities for contractors vs FTEs? we rely on a couple of contractors to close sprints.

Elena: Short term: contractors may be used to bridge sprint-critical work. Long term hiring priority is FTE for core infra and product orgs. We also plan to open two PM roles in product org.

OpsBot: DeployBot: Heads-up: org doc updated in /docs/reorg/transfer-ops.md — last updated 2026-06-01 15:02 UTC

Sahil: appreciate it. last q — does this affect the Dedicated capacity SLA team headcount? that's a customer-impact area.

Elena: Dedicated SLA team will get 2 additional engineers from the infra bucket — started hiring next week, target onboard dates mid-Q3. We'll share role reqs in #eng-hiring when posted.

Maya: thanks, this helps. I'll ping HR about the two flagged folks.

Elena: Thanks everyone — keep q's here or DM HR. We'll summarize in the follow-up email with sticky FAQ.
